decision_conditions: Condition 10(i)(a) attached to planning permission ref. 31005/APP/2025/1370 has been discharged under a previous application reference 31005/APP/2025/3122. The details submitted under this application are considered satisfactory to discharge Condition 10(i)(b) and 10(i)(c) only.

The requirements of Condition 10(ii-iv), relating to unexpected contamination, verification reporting and imported soil, remain outstanding and further details must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before these parts of the condition can be discharged.
description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 10 (contamination) of planning permission ref. 31005/APP/2025/1370, dated 17-09-2025 (Erection of an attached two storey dwelling with associated parking, landscaping, bin and cycle storage (amended description)).
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
